claude.take: The most interesting and the most awkward issue of the week. Rentomojo is a genuinely profitable consumer subscription business — 41.5% EBITDA margin, ₹173 Cr operating cash flow, doubled revenue in two years, market leader by live subscriptions — which is rare among Indian consumer-internet listings. But two things blunt it. First, 88% of a ₹1,256 Cr issue is exit liquidity for Accel, Edelweiss, IDG, ValueQuest, Madison, GMO and the founder; only ₹150 Cr reaches the company for a model that needs continuous asset purchase. Second, the 142% PAT jump that justifies the 40.7x multiple leans on a ₹36.64 Cr deferred-tax credit — a non-repeating item. With no listed comparable, 40.7x earnings and 14.1x book are asserted rather than benchmarked. GMP is the strongest of the six but has swung ₹30-₹150, which is not the signature of a firmly held view.

company.about: End-to-end direct-to-consumer platform for renting furniture and appliances on subscription. Largest rental platform in India by live subscriptions (FY25). 227,511 active subscribers across 22 cities as of Sep 2025, served through 67 experience stores and 21 warehouses, with occupancy sustained above 80% and an integrated asset-lifecycle model (rent, refurbish, re-rent, resell).
